name: staged-delivery-process
body:
The ordered, gated lifecycle a change-set follows end to end in the distributed `codebase-navigator` agent's process: write spec (`spec-writer`) → review spec (`spec-review`) → write plan skeleton (`plan-writer`) → review plan skeleton (`plan-review`) → write plan phases/tasks (`plan-writer`) → review plan phases (`plan-review`) → holistic plan review (`plan-review`) → implement (the owning `implementer`/`*-implementer`) → implementation phase review (`implementation-phase-reviewer`). Each stage has exactly one owning subagent, the stages are ordered, no stage is skipped, and implementation does not begin until the spec and the plan are reviewed green.

Distinct from `domain.entity.task-execution-cadence` (the per-task commit → scan → mark-done ordering that survives the branch graph's staleness guard) and `domain.entity.subagent-session-isolation` (fresh isolated dispatches and the one permitted resume): this entity is the MACRO lifecycle of a change-set, the ordered gated process the navigator's prompt states and follows.
